name: form document
def: The whole authored form as data: metadata, languages, settings and the component tree that the designer edits and the renderer runs.
test: It is the live whole-form definition itself (root plus metadata), not a saved entry or the answers given to it.

name: saved form entry
def: A form document as kept by a host's store: the stored unit with its own id, name or title, and dates, that lists of forms show.
test: It carries storage facts (id, name, saved time) around or beside a document, and is what a list opens; not the tree being edited.

name: form name
def: The human name of a form or document shown in lists and headers, which the author can change.
test: Readable text naming a whole form; not an id, a node label, or a data key.

name: document store
def: The persistence a host supplies: where documents are kept, listed, loaded and removed (memory, file, browser storage, demo server).
test: It holds many documents and has read and write operations; not one document and not the in-memory edit history.

name: draft
def: Work in progress not yet confirmed: the unsaved design kept for later, or a field editor's uncommitted text.
test: The value has not been committed or saved as final; not a snapshot of a drag or a submitted record.

name: format version and migration
def: The number in a document that says which shape of the format it follows, and converting an older shape at load.
test: About the format; not a package version.

name: import boundary
def: Checking and normalizing an untrusted document, pasted or loaded, before normal use.
test: Takes unknown data and yields a document or problems; not checking a person's answers.

name: document problem
def: One finding about a malformed or inconsistent document: a structural error, diagnostic, duplicate key or warning with a path or severity.
test: It is about the authored document, for the author or host; not about an answer failing a rule.

name: document limit
def: A fixed maximum the product sets on documents or their use, such as depth, count, length, rows or body size.
test: A product-wide ceiling constant, not a min or max a rule's author sets.

name: interchange
def: Moving a document in or out as JSON: import, export, download, paste and copy.
test: About carrying a whole form definition between places; not exporting JSON Schema or submitting answers.

name: component node
def: One component instance in the form tree, with key, type, props and children.
test: It lives in a document and has a key; if it describes every instance of a type it is the definition.

name: component definition
def: What a kit registers for one component type: its name, schema, defaults, palette group, icon and renderer.
test: There is one per type in a kit; no node key and no place in a document.

name: component type
def: The name that says which component definition a node uses.
test: A type name string such as Checkbox; not a node key, data key or data type.

name: kit
def: A package or set of component definitions and renderers for one UI library, given to designer and renderer.
test: It names or holds a whole set of components; not one component or a starter bundle of nodes.

name: component renderer
def: The function or React component a kit supplies to draw one component type.
test: Draws one node type from what it receives; not the package that runs the whole form.

name: form renderer
def: The runtime that displays a form document, holds answers, and runs its conditions, rules and actions.
test: It runs the whole form for a person filling it in; not one kit component's drawing code.

name: designer
def: The authoring app component: the whole visual builder that edits a form document.
test: The builder product or its root; not the person using it and not one panel of it.

name: designer shell
def: The outer frame of the designer that lays out its panes, toolbar and shortcuts.
test: The container around panels and canvas, or a ref to its element; not the rendered form or a host page.

name: node key
def: The unique id of a component node in a document's tree.
test: Finds a node in the tree for selection or editing; not where the answer is kept.

name: data key
def: The name under which a field's answer is stored in its scope.
test: Names an entry in the answers; changes when the author renames data, and is not the node key.

name: answer address
def: The computed full place of one answer or node in the answers, including row path and data key.
test: Includes row indexes and pinpoints one answer at run time; a bare data key or a document path is not it.

name: tree edit operation
def: An immutable change to the component tree: add, insert, move, remove, duplicate, rename, replace, update.
test: Returns a new tree from an old one and a key; not a gesture, command or effect.

name: parent-child relation
def: The link between a node and its enclosing container node, and the list of children it holds.
test: About tree position (parent, children, sibling, ancestor, descendant); not a layout or row relation.

name: container
def: A component whose definition accepts children, or a node of such a type.
test: Says children may be put in it; a component that holds one answer is a field instead.

name: field
def: A component that collects an answer, with a data key, label and rules.
test: Holds an answer value from a person; not a property editor row in the inspector.

name: property editor
def: The control in the inspector that edits one property of a node.
test: Edits authored property values for the author; not a field a person fills in and not the JSON editor.

name: component property
def: A named setting (prop) on a component node, declared by its definition's schema.
test: An authored value on a node by property name; not a CSS property and not an answer.

name: property schema
def: The declared type, constraints and traits of a component's properties in its definition.
test: Describes what properties a type accepts and which modes; not the type of an answer and not JSON Schema export.

name: property mode
def: How a property gets its value: static literal, localized, bound to data, or computed.
test: Which kind of value source a property uses; not designer light or dark mode.

name: property binding
def: A stored value that ties a property to data, a context value, a translation or a computation instead of a literal.
test: A tagged object resolved at render time; a plain literal is not a binding.

name: answer
def: One value a person gives in a field.
test: Single value entered or read at run time; a property value or literal in the document is not one.

name: answers record
def: The whole set of answers for a form, keyed by data key.
test: The full record of values, not one value and not the form document.

name: field data type
def: The type an answer must have, such as string, number, array or boolean.
test: Says what an answer's value type is; not the component type or property schema.

name: data scope
def: The set of names in which data keys are resolved: the whole form, or one repeater row.
test: Says which answers a name looks in; not the scope of work or spec.

name: host context
def: Read-only values the host passes in for expressions and bindings, alongside answers.
test: Supplied from outside and read by path; not answers, not a React context, not authored.

name: repeater
def: A container component that shows its children once per entry of a list answer.
test: The container node or type; not one of its repeated entries.

name: repeater row
def: One repeated entry of a repeater, with its own answers and scope.
test: An item in an array of answers; not a row in the tree panel or a layout row.

name: tree panel row
def: One line in the designer's component tree listing, standing for a node at a depth.
test: A visible line for a node in the designer list; no answers in it.

name: row index
def: The position of one entry among a repeater's rows.
test: Counts repeater entries in the answers; the place among sibling nodes is the child index.

name: child index
def: The position of a node among its parent's children.
test: Counts nodes in the authored tree; a repeater entry position is the row index.

name: validation rule
def: An authored constraint an answer must meet, with kind, parameters, message and guard.
test: Stored on a field as a rule; not CSS, lint or kit obligations.

name: rule parameter
def: The limit or argument a rule carries, such as a minimum, pattern, or list of allowed values.
test: A value inside one validation rule; not an action's parameters or a product limit.

name: rule guard
def: The condition that decides whether a validation rule applies.
test: A condition on a rule, not on a component's visibility; not a lint or type guard.

name: validation message
def: The text shown when an answer fails a rule.
test: Per-answer fault text for the person filling in; not a document problem or an action error.

name: validation run
def: Running rules over answers and collecting messages, with when they run (while typing, on blur, on submit).
test: The act or timing of checking answers; not the check of a document at import.

name: condition
def: An authored logical test over answers or context: comparisons joined by and, or and not.
test: A structured test tree yielding true or false; a code string is an expression.

name: comparison and operand
def: A single comparison in a condition: its operator and the two sides, each a field, literal, context value or similar.
test: Part of one comparison; not a binding on a property and not the whole condition tree.

name: visibility condition
def: The condition on a node (renderWhen) that says if it is shown, and the hidden state that follows.
test: Controls showing of one component; a condition that controls a rule is a guard, and a collapsed pane is not hidden by it.

name: expression
def: Author-controlled code or formula text that computes a value or test.
test: A string evaluated by an evaluator; a structured condition is not one.

name: evaluator
def: The function a host supplies to run author-controlled code; core has no default.
test: Runs code, is injected by the host; a resolver of structured conditions is not it.

name: action
def: A named operation a form runs in response to an event: built-in, or code.
test: Something triggered by an event; not a tree edit or a CI action.

name: action reference
def: The stored link on a node's event that names an action and its parameters.
test: A pointer to an action in a document; the action's own definition or code is not it.

name: action parameter
def: Values passed to an action when it is run by a reference.
test: Parameters on a reference or payload to an event; a rule's limits are not.

name: code action
def: An author-written action, held as code and run by the evaluator.
test: Has code and name in the document; built-in actions do not.

name: effect
def: The instruction an action returns for the renderer or host to apply, such as set a value or navigate.
test: Output of an action; not the action and not a React effect.

name: component event
def: A thing that happens to a component (click, change, blur) and runs actions.
test: Named event on a node that can be wired; not a DOM pointer event in the designer.

name: event payload
def: The data that goes with an event the form emits to the host.
test: Carried with an emitted event; not the action's own parameters unless used so.

name: host
def: The application that embeds the designer or renderer and owns storage, network and evaluator.
test: Code outside the packages that supplies callbacks; not a person.

name: author
def: The person who builds a form in the designer.
test: Person who edits the document; not the one answering and not the designer software.

name: respondent
def: The person who fills in a form.
test: Person giving answers in the renderer; not the form's author.

name: submission
def: The act and data of sending a completed form's answers to the host.
test: Answers given at submit; not a draft or a saved document.

name: form step
def: One page of a multi-step form or wizard, and the moving between them.
test: A step a respondent passes; not a step in a list of instructions.

name: form settings
def: Options on the whole form document, such as name, density and languages.
test: Applies to the whole form, stored in it; not per node props or designer preferences.

name: palette
def: The designer panel listing components and presets that can be added.
test: Source list for adding; not a set of colours.

name: palette group
def: The category under which a component appears in the palette.
test: A grouping name of palette entries; not a radio or button group node.

name: component tree panel
def: The designer panel showing the document's nodes as an outline.
test: The panel view of nodes; the node structure itself is the document tree.

name: inspector
def: The designer panel that edits the selected node's properties, styles, rules and events.
test: The right-hand editing panel; not the palette or outline.

name: canvas
def: The designer area where the form is shown for editing by select and drag.
test: Editable view of the form; the preview is the run view.

name: preview
def: The view of the form running as a respondent would see it from the designer.
test: Run-time view with no selection or drag; not the canvas.

name: designer pane
def: A collapsible, resizable side area of the designer with one or more tabs or panels.
test: A region of the shell with a side or width; not a component's own panel element.

name: designer tab
def: A tab that switches what a designer pane or inspector shows.
test: Switches designer views; not a browser tab, a tab stop or a Tabs component.

name: JSON dialog
def: The designer dialog and view that show and edit the document as JSON text.
test: Text editing of the whole document; not a property editor.

name: selection
def: The currently selected node or nodes in the designer, and hover of a node.
test: Keyed by node key in the designer; not a selected option in a choice.

name: drag
def: A pointer drag in the designer, with its source: a palette entry or a node.
test: State of a gesture under way or what is dragged; not where it lands.

name: drop target
def: The place a drag would land: parent, index, slot or zone, and how it is found from a pointer.
test: Where a dropped thing goes; not an action target or a link target.

name: surface
def: A designer area where nodes are drawn and drops resolved, such as canvas or tree panel, with its measured elements.
test: A drawing or drop area registered for hit testing; not a colour token.

name: undo history
def: The stack of earlier and later documents that undo and redo step through.
test: In-memory past and future states.

name: announcement
def: A message sent to the live region for assistive technology.
test: Spoken status text; not a validation message or diagnostic.

name: device
def: A screen size class (mobile, tablet, desktop) with its breakpoint, for styles and preview width.
test: Named size class or its query; the exact canvas size is not it.

name: canvas size
def: The width and height at which the canvas is shown: viewport, or fixed page or screen size, such as paper.
test: A size for the editing area; not the per-device style layer.

name: node styling
def: Authored style on a node: CSS text, declarations, spacing, borders, colours, per device.
test: Look of one node in the document; not theme tokens or designer stylesheet.

name: theme token
def: A named CSS variable that sets the look of designer or HTML kit.
test: A --fs, --fsh or --pg variable or the set of them; not a node's own CSS.

name: designer theme
def: The light, dark or system appearance of the designer chrome.
test: Look mode of the designer; not the form's theme or a property mode.

name: density
def: How compactly form components are spaced and sized.
test: Compact or comfortable setting for a form; not spacing of one node.

name: language
def: A locale the form can be shown in, with tag, name and direction.
test: Identified by tag; not a code language or the term language of docs.

name: translation
def: The text of one message id in one language, or the bundle of them for a language.
test: Text looked up by key for a language; not the language entry.

name: label text
def: The visible name of a component and its help, hint, description or helper text.
test: Text tied to a field for reading; not a designer name of a node.

name: choice option
def: One selectable entry of a select, radio or similar field, with label and value.
test: An entry a respondent picks; not a setting in function options.

name: preset
def: A ready-made set of nodes offered in the palette, with its recipe.
test: Adds several configured nodes at once; not a component definition or a whole form.

name: starting layout
def: A ready-made whole form or layout offered to start from, or a demo example form.
test: Replaces or fills an empty document; not a palette preset.

name: JSON Schema export
def: The projection of a form document into a JSON Schema of its answers.
test: Output schema for answers, with a dialect; not property schemas.

name: image source
def: Where an image component's picture comes from, or a background image and its embedded data.
test: A picture address or data URL; not link addresses.

name: link address
def: The address a link or navigation goes to, and whether it is safe to follow.
test: A URL for going somewhere, with allowed schemes; not an image source or answer address.
